title: 第19章 世间诸般与我无关第20章 局势再变
lines: 一晃眼，又半年过去了。
此时皇帝已经没了开始时的激情，也开始学会纵情享乐。
这一放松下来，他的体重立马飙升，有往他老子那方面发展的趋势。
他意识到自己能力不足了。
而此时外边呢，那十二位中途有些经历过换代，但到了此时，他们都已经成气候。
因为打不进京城，春耕时节，大部分都已经开始经营地盘。
秦国安在外边的日子也不好过，他只是个小将罢了，并不是独领一万人在外边，他也得听从上级命令。
打了好些仗，他这支军队虽然也取得一些成绩，但是对大局势并没有太大帮助，最多也就是局部地区缓和一些。
这日子是越来越难过。
有些新王对待平民还算友好，有些……
一言难尽，总之越来越多的难民涌进京城来乞讨了。
数量过多，造成京城里也变得混乱起来。
皇帝很烦，心一横直接派兵把流民通通赶到一边去。
他倒是也想救灾，但人数太多了，国库和皇帝私库那些钱已经都被他花差不多了。
他老子他爷爷两辈人搜刮民脂民膏得来的财产，被他几个月时间就消耗一空。
真是崽卖爷田不心疼。
他要是有效花销也就罢了，可是拨出去的那些钱实际上连一成都落不到事实上，有些甚至钱发出去就一毛都没有了。
偏偏百官糊弄他玩，他还搞不清楚状况。
这实在是太糟糕了，但凡换个稍微明白点的，直接派先天高手出去将人屠戮一空就行，到时候百官都会怕。
偏偏他也没想到这么做。
就像崇祯，他明明可以控制军权，但就是不手起刀落。
被蒙蔽了，而那些先天高手们也不愿跟他多嘴。
他说什么就做什么，但是想主动教他那还是免了。
万一教得他不满意，那反倒落一个不好，索性什么也不做，他说什么就是什么。
真心帮他也未必被他记住，可是一旦一件事儿没办好，那准被他记恨。
这半年的局势让白羽看得那叫一个过瘾。
作为头号观众，他每天都在各种各样的地方看戏。
看不够，根本看不够。
原来一个王朝末年是这副模样，真是叫人叹为观止。
实在是什么地方看不过眼，白羽也会暗地里出手。
只杀人，不救人。
content_en:
In a blink of an eye, another half year has passed.
At this time, the emperor had lost the initial passion and began to learn to indulge in pleasure.
After he relaxed, his weight immediately soared, and he had a tendency to develop like his father.
He realized that he was not capable enough.
At this time, outside, the twelve people had experienced some changes in the process, but by this time, they had all become established.
Because they couldn't enter the capital, most of them had already started operating their territories during the spring plowing season.
Qin Guoan's life outside was not easy. He was just a young general. He did not lead 10,000 people outside alone. He also had to obey orders from his superiors.
After fighting many battles, although his army has achieved some results, it has not been of much help to the overall situation. At most, it has only eased some local areas.
These days are getting more and more sad.
Some new kings are quite friendly to the common people, and some...
It’s hard to describe, but in short, more and more refugees are pouring into the capital to beg.
The excessive number caused chaos in the capital.
The emperor was very annoyed, and he immediately sent troops to drive all the refugees aside.
He also wanted to provide disaster relief, but there were too many people, and he had already spent almost all the money from the national treasury and the emperor's private treasury.
His father and his grandfather had spent all the property they had acquired from the people in a few months.
I really feel bad for betraying my father.
As long as he spends it effectively, that's all. But in fact, the money allocated is not even 10%, and some even lose a cent after the money is distributed.
But Baiguan was fooling him, and he still couldn't figure out the situation.
This is really too bad. If someone with a little more understanding could just send the innate masters out to kill all the people, then all the officials would be afraid.
But he didn't expect to do this either.
Just like Chongzhen, he could obviously control the military power, but he just didn't use his sword to kill him.
He was deceived, and those innate masters were unwilling to talk to him.
He does whatever he says, but if you want to take the initiative to teach him, you don't have to do it.
If the teaching makes him dissatisfied, it will be a bad thing. He will simply do nothing and let him say whatever he says.
If you sincerely help him, he may not be remembered by him, but once something is not done well, he will definitely be resented.
The situation in the past six months has been extremely enjoyable for Bai Yu to watch.
As the number one spectator, he watches plays in various places every day.
Not enough, not enough at all.
It turns out that the last years of a dynasty looked like this, which is really amazing.
If there is really something he can't see, Bai Yu will take action secretly.
It only kills people, not saves them.
title_en: Chapter 19: Everything in the world has nothing to do with me Chapter 20: The situation changes again
